summary: Verified all three ClientReview/CTA/polling fixes via Playwright on preview URL. (1) Client-side reject popup scrolls internally — .review-reject-form has overflow-y:auto, flex:1, min-height:0; suggestions phase scrollHeight=656 > clientHeight=590, internal scroll brings 'Send concerns' button into viewport. (2) Owner-side ProjectOverview + ProjectDocument sidebar now render a compact ReviewSummary card + CTA (data-testid overview-view-review-cta / doc-review-open-modal); no inline concern text, no inline reply composer; ClientReviewModal (data-testid client-review-modal) opens with concerns, 3 Bracket suggestions, and reply composer for rejected/awaiting states. (3) 6s polling: owner Overview updated from 'AWAITING CLIENT REVIEW' → 'ACCEPTED BY CLIENT' in ~3s after client submitted /api/share/{token}/accept, with toast 'Your client accepted the sign-off.' Reply composer path also verified end-to-end: reply sent, awaiting_reply state rendered, thread persists across modal reopen.

verified_features.detail: review-reject-form computed style: overflowY=auto, flex=1 1 0%, min-height=0px. Panel maxH=652px, overflow=hidden, flex-direction=column. With 1829 chars in textarea (rows=7), form scrollH==clientH=346 (fit) — textarea has its own resize:vertical so long content scrolls inside textarea AND when panel content overflows the flex container scrolls.

Suggestions phase form has scrollH=656 > clientH=590 with overflowY=auto. Initially 'Send concerns' button at bottom=712 (winH=700, out of viewport). After scrollTop=66 within the form (internal scroll), button.bottom=646 → INSIDE viewport. Confirms popup content scrolls, buttons remain reachable.

Wrote 1829-char concern → clicked 'See Bracket suggestions' → AI returned 3 structured suggestions (Ask for the real concern / Restate the core trade-off / Offer a quick sync) → signed 'E2E Client Tester' → 'Send concerns' → review-done-state rendered. share_status transitioned to 'rejected'.

For share_status=rejected: '{ CLIENT REVIEW }' label + 'Client raised concerns.' headline + 140-char preview + ellipsis + CTA 'View concerns & reply' (data-testid overview-view-review-cta). No inline reply composer or full concerns text rendered on the page (only inside modal). For accepted state: same block with 'Client accepted the call.' + signature + CTA 'View acceptance'.

data-testid client-review-modal opens on CTA click. For rejected: shows concerns (crm-concerns-text with 1829 chars), Bracket suggestions (crm-suggestion-0/1/2 with USE THIS DRAFT →), reply composer (crm-reply-text + crm-reply-submit). For accepted: shows 'CLIENT ACCEPTED' body with sections signed count + 'Got it' close (crm-close-accept).

Typed reply (>4 chars) → POST /api/projects/{id}/reply succeeded → toast 'Reply sent. Your client can re-review the same link.' → crm-awaiting-state rendered ('REPLY SENT · AWAITING CLIENT'). share_status becomes awaiting_reply, and share_review is preserved with owner_replies appended.

Sidebar shows 'CLIENT REVIEW' card with 'ACCEPTED' status, 'Signed off. You're clear to ship.', '1/1 items · signed by E2E Client Accept', and CTA 'View acceptance' (data-testid doc-review-open-modal). Clicking opens the same ClientReviewModal with the accept body.

Initial owner Overview page for share_status=sent showed no CTA + 'Sent to client. Awaiting review.' Triggered POST /api/share/{token}/accept from browser JS (no auth) → within ~3 seconds (well under 7s SLA), status pill flipped to 'ACCEPTED BY CLIENT', headline to 'Client accepted the call.', signature block appeared, CTA 'View acceptance' materialized, and toast 'Your client accepted the sign-off.' fired. Repeated flow (implicit) also updated rejected state during earlier tests.

verified_features.feature: Body scroll lock while modals open
verified_features.detail: review-modal-overlay locks document.body.overflow=hidden via useEffect in both ClientReview.jsx and ClientReviewModal.jsx; restored on close.

Only benign 401s from /api/auth/me before session cookie was injected on the client review page (unauthenticated public route). No JS runtime errors on ProjectOverview or ProjectDocument during flows.

critical_code_review_comments: ClientReviewModal.jsx uses hard-coded fetch to /api/projects/{id}/reply via api client — fine. Consider extracting the shared 'review-reject-form' body layout constants between ClientReview RejectFlow and ClientReviewModal to avoid divergence; both currently rely on the same CSS class which is good.

ProjectOverview.jsx polling useEffect key deps: [id, project?.share_status]. Because the effect stops when terminal='accepted', once the client accepts polling stops — that's correct. But note that if state was accepted then owner navigates back, no reload occurs; acceptable for MVP.

Two separate polling useEffects (ProjectOverview + ProjectDocument) both hit /api/projects/{id} every 6s independently — if a user has both pages open in different tabs, each polls independently. Minor; not a leak.

When the ClientReviewModal grows taller than viewport (accepted + rejected + suggestions + replies + composer), the close button (position:absolute top-right of panel) may occasionally sit above visible scrollable content. During re-open test the close button was 'outside of viewport' — user must scroll modal to reach close. Consider making close position:fixed relative to overlay or adding a duplicate bottom close in the composer footer.
Playwright test hint: preview cookies expire; recommend seeding a stable e2e session via OTP_TEST_MODE flow for future automation instead of stealing session_token from curl.
